_comment: Mutation-testing quality gate (#127). 'break' fails the run below this score and is the release-gate floor enforced by the weekly stryker.yaml run. Observed 70.83% on 0.6.0 (net10.0, Standard level, 2026-08-10) after the diagnostics/metrics assertion pass; the floor is set a few points below that so CI-vs-local timeout-mutant variance cannot flake the gate, and is intended to be ratcheted up as further survivors are addressed. Many remaining survivors are equivalent mutants (XmlWriter.Dispose already flushes/closes; the reader's defensive guards recover from mutated positioning logic), so the practical ceiling is well below 100%. Run: `dotnet stryker`.
